title: Schedule Times Added Durations Then Rolled Hours
text: id: COMP-008 domain: math title: Schedule Times Added Durations Then Rolled Hours tags: time, schedule, minutes memory: A schedule answer once came out an hour off because I added minutes in my head while crossing noon. I wrote the durations as one total minute count, converted to hours and leftover minutes, then added that to the start time. The clock stopped being slippery once minutes had their own line.
